expression.description: Serialized Gate expression with operator, optional operands and signal name. Operators are signal, and, or, not, xor and nxor. Signals use NODE.started, NODE.ready, NODE.completed or NODE.failed; absent observations remain unknown.

delaySeconds.description: Standalone admission delay after dependencies are observed. Each graph instance persists its own deadline in status; waits do not occupy workers or slots.

spec.description: Reusable Boolean expression or delay gate controlling admission to the next vertex.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: Gate requires exactly one of expression or delaySeconds

schema.description: Define a Boolean or delay gate. Instances keep delay observations on their containing graph.
